facts.fact: 日记开篇立论：在 CIA 根本不可能被开除，撒谎、骚扰、上班喝酒、害死下属都不算事。
facts.anchor: It was impossible to get fired at CIA

facts.fact: 已关在联邦监狱里的 Rick Ames 按日记作者的说法仍在替 CIA 工作。
俄国蜜罐 Anna Chapman 落网后没有坐牢，几乎立刻被送回俄罗斯。
facts.anchor: Anna Chapman got to go back home to Russia almost immediately

facts.fact: 唯一成功被开除的那个人，关键在于他向上司提起了平等就业机会（EEO）申诉。
facts.anchor: The key to his success in getting fired from CIA was bringing an Equal Employment Opportunity complaint against his Agency bosses

facts.fact: 管理层调出他历年全部工作记录，共 19,892 页，从中找可以点火的材料。
报复的第一步是停他的行动资格、把他关进「惩罚区」。
facts.anchor: They took him off line, stopped him from doing any more ops, stuck him in the Penalty Box

facts.fact: 老友 Shemp 于 2010 年 1 月 5 日签下备忘录，距其部下被炸死仅六天。
facts.anchor: Shemp signed his memo on January 5th, 2010, just six days after several of his brave subordinates were blown to bits

facts.fact: 从他的上司们动手到把他正式踢出，前后用了一年半。
facts.anchor: a year and a half after his Agency managers kicked off their effort
